text.p: Glenborough Realty Trust Inc, a diversified real estate investment trust, on Thursday said it completed the $45.4 million acquisition of a portfolio of six properties.
"This transaction represents the completion of an acquisition announced during the first quarter," Robert Batinovich, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
The properties include two industrial centers, two office buildings, one multifamily residence and one retail center, with a total 615,568 square feet and 224 multifamily units in four states.

The company has only one previously announced deal to complete, the $147.6 million purchase of 27 properties from funds sponsored by investment firm T. Rowe Price. It is expected to close by the end of the second quarter.
